# Health

_SKOS concept in the [PKM Vocabulary](../)._

An area that includes all aspects of your health.

## Scope note

- This area includes everything related to managing and maintaining your health over time throughout your life.
- It includes ongoing responsibilities that includes many efforts, projects, and actions.
